invariants.rationale: The method returns early unless element is null or has name 'properties'.
If not null, element is iterated over, so it must be an array.
properties is dereferenced and passed into methods, so it cannot be null.
If element is not null, either it has size or there is nothing to iterate.
If element is not null, element.name() is compared to "properties", so name() must not be null to pass the check.
